text:
maria: Heads-up 10am1 onboarding for Sienna's LoRA (cust-sienna-v3) on rw-14b-int4. Ran the quick eval-pack and seeing two failure modes: numeric formatting and occasional missing percent signs in financial summaries.

sam: can you paste an example failing prompt/output? also which tokenizer is the adapter built with?

maria: example below and link to the pack: https://s3.internal/sienna/evals/pack-2026-03-21.tgz

```
Prompt: "Invoice summary for acct 6789: line items 3, subtotal $987.20, tax 8.25%"
Gold: "Subtotal: $987.20; Tax: 8.25%; Total: $1,067.18"
rw-14b-int4 (current): "Subtotal $987.2 Tax 8.25 Total 1067.18"
rw-14b-int4 (with tokenizer remap): "Subtotal: $987.20; Tax: 8.25%; Total: $1,067.18"
```

ting: interesting. adapter metadata lists `tokenizer: rhyme-tokenizer@v1.0`, base expects `rw-tokenizer@v1.8`. LoRA should be tokenizer-agnostic but sometimes packaging pulls in vendor tokenizer.

jon: FYI we also saw a similar percent-sign drop in an unrelated cust earlier. Could be tokenization or the detokenizer in int4 code path.

maria: eval-bot results: 22 tests, 19 pass, 3 regressions -> IDs: SIE-INV-01 (percent-loss), SIE-INV-04 (comma-strip), SIE-HALL-02 (extra line-item hallucination). Full CSV: https://s3.internal/sienna/evals/report-5112223334.csv

sam: steps proposed: 1) vendor re-tag tokenizer to rw-tokenizer@v1.8; 2) include both tokenizers in the quick-pack so we can regen without blocking; 3) run quant-sim (int8 proxy) this evening on staging; 4) if regressions persist, run an A/B canary on Dedicated with KV-cache disabled to check runtime interaction.

ting: agree. I'll add a short test that toggles KV-cache steering and records logits delta for the failing prompts. helps prove/disprove runtime flip.

maria: uploaded logits excerpt and seeds for SIE-HALL-02. also noticed that applying simple numeric normalization in postprocess reduces SIE-INV-01 false negatives, but that's a last-resort hack. we should prefer tokenizer parity.

jon: customer timeline? Sienna asked for low-risk deploy next Tue. we have a small window.

maria: plan: vendor retag today, regen pack with dual tokenizers by EOD, sam to run quant-sim tonight (I'll drop results), then int4 compile on staging tomorrow morning. if all green, canary on Dedicated Mon. 

eval-bot: quant-sim report (proxy): latency +3% vs float baseline, token-cost -18% projected for int4. regressions remain: SIE-INV-01, SIE-HALL-02. Details -> https://s3.internal/sienna/reports/quant-sim-5112223334.json

sam: if regressions persist after tokenizer parity, we should consider asking vendor for a LoRA re-export that avoids pulling tokenizer files. that has solved similar packaging issues before.

ting: noted. i'll instrument a tiny diagnostic route that logs tokenized sequences for the failing prompts so vendor can reproduce exactly.

maria: thanks all. i'll post a short status update here after regen and after quant-sim completes. ping @jon if you want to sit in on the canary. :rocket:
